title: Sundays Belong to God
description: In this week's sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner reminds us that Sundays belong to God, and it's time to give Him back His day. Join Pastor Chris as he shares the importance of prioritizing our time with God on the Sabbath and how it can bring us joy, peace, and renewed strength. Don't miss this powerful message on what it means to give God His Sunday and why it's essential for our spiritual well-being.
